title: world_hash_mismatch
display_title: My Minecraft world's file size changed overnight, and I live alone.
beats: My solo parkour world's save file grew by forty megabytes overnight, and I live alone.
I opened it thinking a mod glitched, but my player skin was standing at the finish line, facing the wall.
I hadn't logged in since noon. My PC shows only one login that day: mine.
I checked the world backup from a week ago to compare, just to feel sane again.
In that backup, the same skin is already there, one block further back, like it's been walking toward the finish for days.
I deleted the world an hour ago. Steam still shows it installed, and the file size just went up again.
